scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/preload/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload/preload.js && esbuild src/renderer/renderer.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=dist/renderer/renderer.js && mkdir -p dist/renderer && cp src/renderer/index.html dist/renderer/index.html && mkdir -p dist/renderer/ort && cp node_modules/onnxruntime-web/dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs node_modules/onnxruntime-web/dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm node_modules/onnxruntime-web/dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.mjs node_modules/onnxruntime-web/dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.wasm dist/renderer/ort/
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run build:tests
scripts.test:reliability: npm run build && npm run build:tests && node --test dist-tests/tests/reliability/**/*.test.js
